reviewer: Kimi actual visual comparison of exact source, enlarged source page, complete unchanged native RGBA, full white/cyan/alpha sheet and unchanged mascot reference

remaining_reasons: The exact source has a clearly visible pair of dark eyebrows, but this return leaves the brow area smooth yellow without distinct eyebrow hair. Restore two separate dark-brown eyebrow hair shapes above the green-ringed eyes; do not substitute a bare mascot forehead. This is a clearly visible source-feature loss, not an unreadable tiny detail.
entries.positive_observation: The former matte halo is absent on the full white/cyan comparisons. Side-parted dark hair, one upper-lip moustache with a bare chin, one closed mouth below it, olive closed collar with paired gold tabs, shoulder details/buttons and the diagonal strap remain recognizable. The short broad collar transition is sound and there are no visible interior holes or see-through clothes. Native alpha is not a rejection reason.
entries.next_art_attempt: external-03 with the same original/reference inputs and transparent route, explicitly restoring both source-visible eyebrows while retaining the successful alpha, moustache/chin, uniform and collar
